rules.rule: Every F-2 requirement expressed as a multiple of per-capita GNI uses the Bank of Korea's per-capita GNI for the previous year, as first published in March. Immigration applies it from 1 April of the publication year to 31 March of the next year. For applications filed 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 the figure is the 2025 GNI of KRW 52,416,000. Applications filed 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 used the 2024 GNI of KRW 49,955,000. Immigration keeps using the March preliminary figure; the Bank of Korea's June 2026 revision to KRW 52.57M does not replace it.
rules.conditions: Any F-2 rule worded '전년도 1인당 GNI' (F-2-3 spouse, F-2-71 sponsor, F-2-T multiples).
rules.stacks: The only exception is E-7, which keeps the 2024 figure of KRW 49.95M until 2027-03. It does not apply to any F-2 sub-code.
rules.source: HiKorea GNI notice (Mar 2026), as reposted by 경남 이주민 상담기관 https://www.gnscfw.org/1303. The Bank of Korea's '2025년 4/4분기 및 연간 국민소득(잠정)' (2026-03-10) is restated by KDI at https://eiec.kdi.re.kr/policy/materialView.do?num=277800.
rules.quote: 적용 GNI는 5,241.6만원 / 적용기간 '26.4.1.~'27.3.31. / GNI 기준을 요건으로 하는 모든 체류자격 / 특정활동(E-7) 자격에 한해 '24년 기준인 4,995만원 적용(~'27.3.까지); BoK: 1인당 GNI 원화 기준 5,241만 6,000원, 달러 기준 36,855달러

rules.rule: Pre-computed GNI multiples for the window now in force (2026-04-01..2027-03-31), with the previous window's figures in brackets.
rules.conditions: Arithmetic on the GNI baseline rule above.
rules.source: Computed from KRW 52,416,000 and KRW 49,955,000. The 70% figure of 34,968,500 also appears verbatim in the K드림외국인지원센터 F-2-R notice.
rules.quote: 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 70% 이상(3496만 8500원)

rules.rule: Which GNI year applies when the previous year's GNI has not yet been published (January to March): the year before that. The 자목 notice states this for F-2-7. It is the legal basis of the April-to-March switch-over.
rules.conditions: Applications filed before the March Bank of Korea release.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2025-408호 (2025-10-24), 출입국관리법시행령 별표 1의2 중 24. 거주(F-2)자목 기준 고시 제2조. Read via the law.go.kr mirror https://github.com/legalize-kr/admrule-kr.
rules.quote: 연간소득이 전년도(발표되지 않은 경우 전전년도)의 1인당 국민총소득의 1.5배 이상인 사람

rules.rule: Time spent on any 거주(F-2) status counts toward the general F-5-1 permanent residence (5 years on D-7..E-7 or F-2, adult), so every F-2 sub-code is a potential feeder for F-5-1. The manual may narrow this by sub-code; that is not verified.
rules.conditions: Adult under the Civil Act, plus the F-5-1 income and KIIP 5 requirements (outside this topic).
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제1호, as quoted by the earlier audit from law.go.kr (visa-map-audit/findings.md, F-2-3 -> F-5-1).
rules.quote: 별표 1의2 중 10. 주재(D-7)부터 20. 특정활동(E-7)까지의 체류자격이나 별표 1의2 중 24. 거주(F-2) 체류자격으로 5년 이상 대한민국에 체류하고 있는 사람

rules.rule: 5+ years of continuous stay in Korea, counting only time on the eligible statuses (periods on different eligible statuses add up), with the applicant's life base in Korea. Eligible statuses: D-1, D-5, D-6, D-7, D-8 (see the D-8 rule below), D-9, E-1, E-2, E-3, E-4, E-5, E-6-1, E-6-3, E-7 (every E-7 sub-code), and F-1 (Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese only).
rules.stacks: Statuses not on the list do not count: D-2, D-4, D-10, E-6-2, E-8, E-9, E-10, H-2, G-1, B/C, F-3, F-4, F-6. For example, E-9 years before E-7-4 do not count.
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의2 24. 거주(F-2) 바목, quoted by the earlier audit from law.go.kr. KIS 비자 내비게이터 PART 02 ❹ 장기체류자(F-2-99) 자격 요건 p.35 (https://www.immigration.go.kr/bbs/immigration_eng/230/454086/download.do), checked by the earlier verifier. Manual 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주(F-2) › 9. 기타 장기체류자.
rules.quote: 외교(A-1)부터 협정(A-3)까지의 체류자격 외의 체류자격으로 대한민국에 5년 이상 계속 체류하여 생활 근거지가 국내에 있는 사람으로서 법무부장관이 인정하는 사람 / 신청 대상 체류자격 : 문화예술(D-1), 취재(D-5), 종교(D-6), 주재(D-7), 기업투자(D-8)*, 무역경영(D-9), 교수(E-1), ... 예술흥행(E-6-1, 3), 특정활동(E-7), 방문동거(F-1)

rules.rule: Years on F-1 count only for Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese (화교) who are not entered in their home country's household register. Other F-1 holders are not eligible.
rules.effect: Narrows the F-1 route to a single group.
rules.source: kormoya.com '[F-2-99] 장기체류자 -> 거주체류자격 변경 요건', which restates the manual. Lead only.
rules.quote: 방문동거(F-1)는 본국 호적에 등록되지 않은 국내 출생 대만 화교

rules.rule: D-8 years count only if the foreign investment still held on the application date is at least the FIPA threshold of KRW 100M. This hits D-8-2 and D-8-4, which have no investment requirement of their own.
rules.effect: Excludes D-8 holders whose investment is under KRW 100M.
rules.source: KIS 비자 내비게이터 p.35, footnote. The earlier verifier confirmed it verbatim (SURVIVED finding).
rules.quote: * 기업투자(D-8) 자격자는 신청 당시 투자금액이 현행 「외국인투자촉진법」 상의 투자기준금액(1억원) 이상인 자에 한함

rules.rule: The applicant's own income for the previous calendar year must be at least KRW 40,000,000, proven with the tax office's income amount certificate (소득금액증명). The spouse's income is not added. The amount is fixed in KRW and is not a GNI multiple. If the certificate cannot be issued yet, the applicant submits all three: withholding receipts, bank records showing the pay, and a pledge signed by employer and applicant.
rules.conditions: Rule in force since the guideline change of 2025-07-07 (secondary sources).
rules.stacks: No household combination. Secondary sources also say the income rule of the status currently held must be met if it is higher.
rules.source: kbizon.com 'F-2-99 비자' and kormoya.com, both summarising the manual (updates of 2024.10.14 and 2025.9.9). lawyeon-immigration.com (2026). korea-visa.co.kr (says 2025-07-07). The document list in data/visadocs.yaml F-2-99.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 9) confirms the income proofs. Leads.
rules.quote: 배우자 소득 합산은 인정하지 않고 신청인 본인의 연간소득만 심사 / 전년도 연간소득 기준 4,000만원 이상이며, 세무서가 발급한 소득금액증명을 기준으로 심사 / 신청일 당시 소득금액증명원 제출이 불가한 경우 (㉠~㉢ 모두 제출)

rules.rule: The applicant must own assets of at least KRW 20,000,000 in their own name. Only assets held continuously for 6+ months before the application count, valued as net assets after loans (deposits, savings, securities). Lapsing (non-refundable) insurance does not count.
rules.conditions: Rule in force since the 2025-07-07 guideline change (secondary sources).
rules.stacks: Both the income and the asset test must be met.
rules.source: kbizon.com and lawyeon-immigration.com (2026), summarising the manual. Leads.
rules.quote: 신청인 본인 명의 자산 2,000만 원 이상 / 신청일 기준 6개월 이상 계속 보유하고 있는 자산만 인정하며, 대출금액을 제외한 순자산을 기준으로 산정

rules.rule: Superseded rule, recorded here so it is not re-applied. Before 2025-07-07: assets of KRW 15M (KRW 30M including accompanying family); own income at least 12x the previous year's monthly minimum wage; or, when inviting family, family income combined at least GNI. One older source says 1.5x GNI for the combined case.
rules.amount: Old: assets KRW 15M / 30M; income 12x monthly minimum wage (about KRW 24.1M on the 2023 wage)
rules.effect: Replaced by the KRW 40M / KRW 20M own-only rule.
rules.source: immikorea.com F-2-99 page (2024) and kormoya.com. Leads.
rules.quote: 자산은 본인이 신청하는 경우 1,500만원 이상 ... 동반가족 초청 시에는 ... 합산 3,000만원 이상 / 연간소득은 본인 신청시 전년도 월단위 최저임금의 12배이상

rules.rule: Exempt from the livelihood (income and asset) test: Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese, and D-6 religious workers with 10+ years in Korea who are recommended by a central ministry or the head of a local government.
rules.effect: The income and asset thresholds are waived.
rules.stacks: The KIIP requirement still applies to D-6 holders. Korea-born Taiwanese are also exempt from KIIP.
rules.source: Secondary summaries of the manual (search results citing yoonhjs.com uid=444 and kbizon.com). Lead.
rules.quote: 국내 출생 대만 화교, 국내 10년 이상 체류 중인 종교(D-6) 자격자로 중앙부처 또는 자치단체장의 추천을 받은 자는 생계유지 능력 심사가 면제

rules.rule: Basic Korean language and culture (기본소양): KIIP level 4 completed, or KIIP pre-test score 81+, or graduation from a Korean elementary, middle or high school, university, graduate school or polytechnic, or a pass in the Korean qualification exam (검정고시). TOPIK is not on the list. Exempt: proof at KIIP-4 level already on file, Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese, former Korean nationals.
rules.source: Manual 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주(F-2) › 체류자격 변경허가 › 9. 기타 장기체류자 › 체류자격 변경 심사, document '한국어와 한국문화에 대한 기본소양 입증서류', as transcribed in data/visadocs.yaml (F-2-99.change).
rules.quote: 한국어와 한국문화에 대한 기본소양 입증서류 (visadocs note: One of: KIIP level 4 completed; KIIP pre-test 81+; Korean elementary/middle/high school graduation; Korean university/graduate school/polytechnic graduation; Korean qualification exam pass)

rules.rule: Granted only by change of status inside Korea; there is no consular F-2-99 visa. The applicant must still be working or running a business on the application date (employees show a contract or employment certificate, owners the corporate registry). The spouse and minor children get F-3-18, not F-2-99.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-99 (change and extend lists only) and F-3 change case 'Spouse or minor child of an F-2-99 holder (F-3-18)', from manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 9 › 라. 동반가족.
rules.quote: 9. 기타 장기체류자에 대한 거주 자격 변경허가 › 라. 동반가족 › 체류자격 변경 (F-3-18)

rules.rule: F-2-R is governed by 별표 1의2 24 파목 and its notice, 법무부고시 제2026-248호. The notice was amended and took effect on 2026-08-03, so it is the version in force now.
rules.source: admrule-kr mirror of law.go.kr: 법무부/_본부/고시/출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의2 중 24. 거주(F-2) 파목에 관한 기준 고시 (metadata only; the text is in the PDF at law.go.kr flSeq=167486017).

rules.rule: Qualifying route, either one: (a) a Korean associate degree (전문학사) or higher, earned after 2+ years of study in Korea on D-2; or (b) own annual income for the previous year at least the annual living wage (생활임금) of the province or metropolitan city issuing the recommendation. Since 2025-07-02 the income test is the regional living wage; before that it was 70% of GNI. Living wages differ by region, roughly KRW 29-31M a year, about 56-59% of 1x GNI.
rules.amount: Regional living wage x 12 months. Examples: 전라남도 2026 KRW 12,305/h = KRW 2,571,745/month = about KRW 30,860,940/yr; 경북 2025 KRW 29,268,360; 충북 2025 KRW 29,601,924. Old rule: 70% GNI = KRW 34,968,500.
rules.effect: A regional-wage floor at about 57-59% of GNI replaced the old 70%-of-GNI floor.
rules.stacks: The degree route needs no income test at all.
rules.source: Notice text (2025 version) reprinted at yoonhjs.com uid=1864. K드림외국인지원센터 notice '2025년 F-2-R 소득 기준 변경 안내 (2025. 7. 2. 시행)'. 남도일보 (2026) Jeonnam recruitment notice. Leads; the 2026-248 PDF itself could not be read.
rules.quote: 유학(D-2) 체류자격의 대상 교육기관에 입학하여 국내에서 2년 이상 체류하며 학칙으로 정하는 과정을 마치고 전문학사 이상의 학위를 취득 / 소득요건 기준이 기존 GNI에서 광역자치단체 생활임금으로 / 전년도 소득이 2026년 전라남도 생활임금(시급 1만2천305원·월 257만1천745원) 이상인 합법체류 외국인

rules.rule: Recommendation: a letter from the head of the province or metropolitan city (광역지방자치단체장), valid for 3 months from issue and for one application only. The target area (추천지역) is a depopulating area (인구감소지역) or an area of concern (인구감소관심지역) submitted by the head of the basic local government. Local governments may add their own conditions. The 2025-26 plan covers 107 areas (89 depopulating + 18 of concern).
rules.source: Notice definition quoted via search (yoonhjs.com uid=1864). data/visadocs.yaml F-2-R.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 37 › Ⅱ › (1) › 4. 제출서류): '지자체장 추천서' note 'Within 3 months of issue; valid for one application'. MOJ press release 2025-02-20.
rules.quote: "추천지역"이란 제6조제1항에 따라 지역특화형 우수인재(F-2-R) 외국인을 추천 대상으로 제출한 기초지방자치단체의 장이 관할하는 인구감소지역 등을 말한다.

rules.rule: The 5 years are a commitment for the future, not a past-residence requirement: the applicant must intend to live, work or run a business in the recommended area for 5+ years from the day F-2-R is granted. They must actually live in the area at the time of application. A special rule lets an applicant who has not yet moved in submit a lease and move in within 30 days after the change. Secondary sources add that the first 2 years must be spent living in the recommended area itself.
rules.amount: 5 years (forward); first 2 years in the recommended area
rules.effect: Nobody needs 5 past years in the region.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2026-248호 제4조제1항제3호, as read from the PDF by the earlier audit (findings.md 'wrong-note: F-2-R'). visadocs F-2-R.change 실거주 인정 특례. yoonhjs.com F-2-R summary for the 2-year clause.
rules.quote: 지역특화형 우수인재(F-2-R) 체류자격을 받은 날로부터 5년 이상 추천지역에서 거주하거나 취업 또는 창업활동을 하고자 할 것 / 허가일 기준 최초 2년은 추천지역에 실거주해야 하며, 2년 경과 시 허용지역으로 이전 가능

rules.rule: From 2026-08-03: KIIP level 3 completed, or a KIIP pre-test placement at level 4 or higher, or TOPIK level 3 or higher, valid on the application date. From 2025-02-20 to 2026-08-02 the bar was KIIP 4 / TOPIK 4. The 2025 findings that call for level 4 are therefore out of date.
rules.conditions: Change to F-2-R on or after 2026-08-03.
rules.effect: Relaxed by one level, from 4 to 3.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-R.change document '기본소양 요건 입증서류' (manual 2026.9.18 › 37 › Ⅱ › (1) › 4). jobploy.kr '2026 Regional Specialized Visa Latest Update' (effective 2026-08-03). MOJ press release 2025-02-20 for the 2025 rise to level 4.
rules.quote: visadocs note: 'At least one, valid on the application date: KIIP level-3 completion or pre-test placement at level 4+; TOPIK level 3+ score report'; 2025 보도자료: 한국어 능력 기준은 기존 사회통합프로그램 3단계[또는 TOPIK 3급] 이상에서 4단계[또는 TOPIK 4급] 이상으로 상향

rules.rule: The applicant must be employed by, or run a business in, the recommended area. The employer's eligibility is checked (business registration, national and local tax certificates, social and employment insurance lists, SME or farm-corporation confirmation). Since 2026-05-18 a pilot also lets small businesses in depopulating areas hire F-2-R holders.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-R.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 37 › Ⅱ › (1) › 4). jobploy.kr / youthassembly.kr on the 지역활력 외국인 고용특례 (pilot from 2026-05-18).
rules.quote: documentsToCheckTheEmployerSEligibility / documentsForTheSmallBusinessHiringExcept (visadocs)

rules.rule: Statuses barred from changing to F-2-R: D-3, D-4, E-6-2, E-8, E-9, E-10, G-1, H-1, and D-10 holders whose previous status was one of these. This is the 2024 list; whether it is unchanged in 2026 is not confirmed.
rules.source: yoonhjs.com '지역특화형비자(F2R비자) - 우수인재 부분 정리_24.3.12기준', cross-checked with other agency pages. Lead.
rules.quote: 기술연수(D-3), 일반연수(D-4), 호텔유흥(E-6-2), 계절근로(E-8), 비전문취업(E-9), 선원취업(E-10), 기타(G-1), 관광취업(H-1) ... 구직(D-10) 자격 소지자 중 직전 체류자격이 상기 제한 대상에 해당하는 자

rules.rule: Route for E-9/E-10 workers: 2+ years on E-9 or E-10 plus the E-7-4 points test leads to E-7-4R. After 3+ years on E-7-4R in the depopulating area, the holder can change to F-2-R. A direct E-7-4 to F-2-R change is not allowed in principle; the usual path is E-7-4 > E-7-4R > F-2-R.
rules.amount: 3 years on E-7-4R in the area
rules.source: MOJ press release '2025년 지역특화형 비자 운영계획' (2025-02-20, moj.go.kr/bbs/moj/182/477721), as summarised in search results. yoonhjs.com 'E-7-4 비자에서 F-2-R(지역특화형 거주)로 직접 변경 가능한가?'.
rules.quote: E-7-4R 비자 소지자가 해당 지역에서 3년 이상 체류하면 지역특화 우수인재(F-2-R) 비자로 전환 / 원칙적으로는 불가능하며, E-7-4 비자 소지자는 일반적으로 E-7-4R ... 자격으로 먼저 전환

rules.rule: Granted only by change of status inside Korea; there is no consular route. Every F-2 sub-code may move to F-2-R by a change of status. The spouse and minor children get F-3-1R. Youth raised in Korea have their own F-2-R track (manual ch.38); at extension only the residence requirement is checked for them.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-R (change and extend lists only), the 'within' list (F-2-x>F-2-R use change), F-3 change case F-3-1R, and F-2-R.extend case citing manual 2026.9.18 › 38 › Ⅲ › 3.
rules.quote: Regional talent (F-2-R) who got the status through the special track for foreign youth raised in Korea – only the residence requirement applies

rules.rule: Top-Tier is defined by 법무부고시 제2026-160호 (amended and in force 2026-06-01), under 별표 1의2 24 자목.
rules.source: admrule-kr mirror: 출입국관리법시행령 별표1의2 중 24. 거주(F-2) 자목에 해당하는 자 중 첨단분야 최우수인재(Top-Tier) 자격 기준 및 대상에 관한 고시 (metadata only; the PDF is at law.go.kr flSeq=164397745).

rules.rule: Advanced-industry track. All of these are required: (1) a master's or doctorate from a world top-100 university; (2) either 8+ years of experience in an advanced field including 3+ years at a global top-500 company, or 5+ years of post-doctoral research including 3+ years at a government-led institute, a top-100 university institute or a global-500 corporate institute; (3) own annual income of at least 3x GNI; (4) verification and recommendation by the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
rules.conditions: Visa from abroad or change in Korea.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2026-160호 [첨단산업 분야] 가. 자격 기준, as read by the earlier audit (findings.md 'wrong-needs: F-2-T'). korea.kr policy news 148940244.
rules.quote: 세계순위 100위 이내 대학의 석박사 학위를 취득하고, 세계 500대 기업 3년 이상 근무를 포함한 8년 이상 경력자

rules.rule: Relaxations (나. 대상자). Only one leg can be dropped at a time. Without the top-100 degree, or without the career leg, the income floor rises to 4x GNI. Inside Korea the income leg can be replaced: after 1+ year working in an advanced field on D-7..E-7 or F-2, a person who meets every other criterion qualifies with income of at least 2x GNI plus a central-ministry recommendation.
rules.conditions: 4x: the degree OR the career criterion is missing. 2x: change of status after 1+ year in an advanced field in Korea.
rules.stacks: No stacking: the 2x route still needs both the degree and the career criteria.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2026-160호 나. 대상자 (earlier audit). Manual 2026.9.18 › 39 › Ⅰ › 2 톱티어 거주(F-2-T) › 사증발급 및 체류자격 변경, as reprinted on yoonhjs.com.
rules.quote: 주재(D-7) ~ 특정활동(E-7) 또는 거주(F-2) 자격으로 1년 이상 첨단분야에 취업한 사람 중 소득요건을 제외한 최우수인재 자격 기준을 모두 충족한 사람으로서, 1인당 GNI 2배 이상 소득을 유지하고, 관계 중앙행정기관의 추천을 받은 자

rules.rule: Science and technology track: 5+ years of experience plus a principal-investigator, assistant-professor-or-higher or 책임급 position, and a recommendation from the Ministry of Science and ICT.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2026-160호 (earlier audit). data/visadocs.yaml F-2-T.change case 'Top-tier talent in science and technology (recommended by the Ministry of Science and ICT)'.
rules.quote: Ⅱ. 과학기술 분야 › 2 톱티어 거주(F-2-T)

rules.rule: Granted both ways: an e-visa from abroad (사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 39) or a change of status in Korea (D-10-T, D-7..E-7, F-2). No KIIP or TOPIK requirement was found for F-2-T itself; KIIP 3 / TOPIK 3 is required later, for F-5-T. Family: spouse and minor children get F-2-T1, parents F-1-15, domestic helpers F-1-24.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-T (abroad route e-visa; change), F-2-T1, and F-1 extend (F-1-15, F-1-24).
rules.quote: 톱티어 거주 동반가족(부모, F-1-15) / 톱티어 거주 가사보조인(부모, F-1-24) › 사증발급·체류자격 변경·체류기간 연장

rules.rule: Spouse or minor child of an F-2-T holder. The manual covers visa issuance from abroad, change of status in Korea and extension. The only listed proof is the family relationship (apostilled). No income or language requirement was found.
rules.source: Manual 2026.9.18 › 39. 톱티어(Top-Tier) 비자 › Ⅳ. 동반 가족 등 › 톱티어 거주 동반가족(배우자·미성년자녀) › 사증발급·체류자격 변경·체류기간 연장, as transcribed in data/visadocs.yaml.
rules.quote: □ 톱티어 거주 동반가족(배우자·미성년자녀) › 사증발급·체류자격 변경·체류기간 연장

rules.rule: Legal ground: the spouse of an F-5 holder, and that holder's minor child (under 19).
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의2 24. 거주(F-2) 가목, as quoted by the earlier audit from law.go.kr.
rules.quote: 국민의 미성년 외국인 자녀 또는 별표 1의3 영주(F-5) 체류자격을 가지고 있는 사람의 배우자 및 그의 미성년 자녀

rules.rule: Spouse invitation: over the 12 months before the application date, the F-5 holder's own income, or the combined income of the household members sharing a livelihood and living together, must be at least the previous year's per-capita GNI. Counted: wages, business income (including freelance, farming and fishing), property rent, interest, dividends, pensions. Irregular one-off income is excluded. The notice sets the same standard every year unless a new notice is issued.
rules.conditions: The inviter is an F-5 holder bringing a spouse to live together (결혼동거 목적). The notice is written for the visa; the manual applies the same standard to a change of status (assumption, see open questions).
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2015-2호 영주자격자의 배우자 결혼 동거 목적 사증 발급에 필요한 소득요건 고시 (시행 2015-01-07), admrule-kr mirror of law.go.kr.
rules.quote: 외국인을 결혼동거 목적으로 초청하는 영주자격 소지자(초청자)는 신청일 기준 과거 1년간의 본인 또는 생계를 같이 하는 동거가족의 소득 합계*가 한국은행고시 전년도 일인당 국민총소득GNI 이상** 이어야 함 / 근로소득+사업소득(프리랜서, 농림수산업소득 포함)+부동산 임대소득+이자소득+배당소득+연금소득의 합계로 하되, 이외 비정기적 소득은 제외함

rules.rule: If the household sharing a livelihood, counting the inviter, has 3 members or fewer, 70% of GNI is enough. With 4 or more members the full 1x GNI applies.
rules.conditions: Household of 3 or fewer, inviter included.
rules.stacks: Only one reduction step; no further cut was found.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2015-2호 (admrule-kr mirror).
rules.quote: 본인 포함 생계를 같이하는 동거가족의 수가 3인 이하인 경우에는 GNI 70% 이상이면 인정

rules.rule: The income requirement is waived on humanitarian grounds, for example a child born to the inviter and invitee, or a pregnancy. Two other conditions: an inviter whose F-5 came under 별표 1의3 제2호 (spouse of a Korean, F-5-2) may invite only 3+ years after getting F-5, and nobody may invite another spouse within 5 years. Both spouses must have clean criminal records and health certificates.
rules.effect: Income test waived for a common child or pregnancy.
rules.source: Korean consulate in Toronto (mofa.go.kr ca-toronto-ko, '[F-2-3] F-5 소지자의 배우자 및 미성년 자녀'), seen as a search-result summary only. The criminal-record and health documents are in data/visadocs.yaml F-2-3.
rules.quote: 초청인과 피초청인 사이에 출생한 자녀가 있거나 임신한 경우 등 인도적 사유가 있는 경우 / 초청인이 출입국관리법 시행령 별표1의3 제2호에 따라 영주자격을 취득한 경우 영주자격 취득 후 3년이 경과해야 함 / 최근 5년 이내에 다른 배우자를 초청한 이력이 없을 것

rules.rule: The minor child of an F-5 holder has no published income test: notice 2015-2 covers only spouse (결혼동거) invitations.
rules.effect: No income threshold for the child.
rules.source: Inference from the scope of 법무부고시 제2015-2호 (title and text cover 결혼동거 only). The visadocs F-2-3 'Minor child' case has no income document.
rules.quote: 영주자격자의 배우자 결혼 동거 목적 사증 발급에 필요한 소득요건 고시

rules.rule: Routes: the spouse can get a single-entry F-2-3 visa at a consulate (stay up to 1 year) or change status in Korea. The minor child can change in Korea, or come from abroad on a CCVI (visa issuance confirmation obtained in Korea). Short-term statuses (B-1, B-2, C-3, C-4, H-1) cannot change in Korea and must apply abroad.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-3 (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 체류자격 변경허가 › 2; 사증발급 매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 30 › 공관장 재량 › 1). visa-map-audit/verified-by-review.md for the short-term rule.
rules.quote: Spouse of an F-5 holder: single-entry F-2-3 visa, stay up to 1 year

rules.rule: The spouse or minor child of an F-2-7 (or F-2-7S) holder gets F-2-71 only if the F-2-7 holder's own annual income is at least the latest per-capita GNI. If it is lower, the family is given F-1 (visiting status), or a 90-day single-entry F-3-18 visa from abroad. The family moves to F-2-71 once the holder's income reaches GNI: F-3-18 to F-2-71 is a documented in-Korea change.
rules.conditions: The family member holds F-2-7 or F-2-7S.
rules.effect: Below GNI: F-1 or F-3-18 instead of F-2-71.
rules.stacks: No household combination was found; the F-2-7 holder's own income counts.
rules.source: Manual 2026.9.18 › 29. 방문동거(F-1) › 체류기간 연장허가 › 11. 점수제 우수인재(F-2-7)의 배우자 또는 미성년자녀, and 사증발급 매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 31 › 공관장 재량 "2." (F-3-18), both as transcribed in data/visadocs.yaml. visadocs within 'F-3-18>F-2-71: use change'.
rules.quote: visadocs F-1 extend case: 'Spouse or minor child of a points-based talent (F-2-7) whose annual income is below the latest per-capita GNI' (source: 29. 방문동거(F-1) › 체류기간 연장허가 › 11. 점수제 우수인재(F-2-7)의 배우자 또는 미성년자녀)

rules.rule: From abroad, F-2-71 is issued on a CCVI. The main holder's latest-year income certificate from the tax office must be issued within 2 years before applying. For people employed, or about to be employed, by a KOSPI- or KOSDAQ-listed company who cannot submit it, the salary in the employment contract is used instead. In Korea it is a change of status. There is no KIIP or TOPIK requirement for the family member.
rules.effect: Listed-company exception: contract salary replaces the tax certificate.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-71.abroad (사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 30 › 사증발급인정서 발급대상 › 1 › 첨부서류 2)) and F-2-71.change.
rules.quote: incomeAmountCertificate note: 'Latest-year income certificate issued by the tax office within 2 years before applying. Only for people employed (or to be employed) by a KOSPI/KOSDAQ-listed company who cannot submit it, the salary in the employment contract is used instead.'

rules.rule: Three grounds, any one: (1) invested US$500K or more and has stayed 3+ continuous years on D-8; (2) executive or employee sent by a foreign company that invested US$500K or more to its Korean foreign-invested company, staying 3+ continuous years; (3) invested US$300K or more and employs 2 or more Korean nationals. All three require foreign-investor standing under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act. No GNI test.
rules.amount: US$500K + 3 years, or US$300K + 2 Korean employees (about KRW 0.42bn at about 1,400 KRW/USD)
rules.conditions: Foreign investor under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act.
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의2 24. 거주(F-2) 라목, quoted verbatim by the earlier verifier (SURVIVED finding). data/visadocs.yaml F-2-5.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 4. 고액투자자).
rules.quote: 라. 「외국인투자 촉진법」에 따른 외국투자가 등으로 다음의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람: 1) 미화 50만 달러 이상을 투자한 외국인으로서 기업투자(D-8) 체류자격으로 3년 이상 계속 체류하고 있는 사람 2) 미화 50만 달러 이상을 투자한 외국법인이 ... 파견한 임직원으로서 3년 이상 계속 체류하고 있는 사람 3) 미화 30만 달러 이상을 투자한 외국인으로서 2명 이상의 국민을 고용하고 있는 사람

rules.rule: Granted only by change of status inside Korea: visadocs has change and extend lists but no consular list. No KIIP or TOPIK requirement.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-5
rules.quote: 4. 고액투자자에 대한 거주자격 변경허가

rules.rule: Tourism and resort property investment (real-estate investment immigration). At least KRW 1bn in designated property in one of 8 designated areas: Jeju; Incheon Free Economic Zone (Songdo, Yeongjong, Cheongna); Busan Osiria tourism complex (Haeundae Tourism Resort removed from 2026-05-20); Yeosu Hwayang; Yeosu Gyeongdo; Pyeongchang Alpensia; Donghae Mangsang (designation 2025-04-01 to 2026-12-31); Pyeongchang Yongpyong (to 2030-03-31). The other designations run to 2027-12-31. Eligible property: resort condominiums, lodging, tourist pensions, sports-linked housing, and holiday homes where still allowed (excluded in several areas since 2018-05-01). Legacy amounts: KRW 500M for those who invested before the May 2023 notice; KRW 700M at Yeosu Hwayang before the January 2025 notice. The investor or a corporate executive or shareholder qualifies, with own funds brought in from abroad (FX remittance proof).
rules.conditions: Designated area and property type, within the designation period.
rules.effect: Legacy lower amounts apply only to investments made before the dates stated.
rules.stacks: Can be combined with public-interest (F-2-12) investment to reach that threshold.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2026-29호 (2026-02-11, 시행 2026-02-17), 출입국관리법시행령 별표 1의2 제24호 거주(F-2) '차'목 부동산 투자지역·대상·기준, admrule-kr mirror (api-text). data/visadocs.yaml F-2-8.change for the FX proof.
rules.quote: 10억 원 이상 (2023. 5. 고시일 이전까지는 5억 원 이상) / 10억 원 이상 (2025. 1. 고시일 이전까지는 7억 원 이상) / 해운대관광리조트는 2026년 5월 20일부터 투자대상에서 제외됨

rules.rule: Change of status inside Korea, including from visa-free or short-term entry (manual chapter 6 change list; no consular list in visadocs). Permanent residence (F-5-17) after keeping the investment for 5 years. No income, GNI or language test.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-8 (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 6. 관광·휴양시설 투자 외국인에 대한 거주(F-2-8, F-2-81)자격 변경허가). 법무부고시 제2023-319호 Ⅱ (5-year rule, stated for both schemes).
rules.quote: 투자 기준금액 이상 투자하고 거주(F-2) 체류자격을 받은 후 5년간 투자상태 유지 시 영주자격 부여

rules.rule: Family of a tourism and resort investor: the spouse and the unmarried children. Adult children qualify if unmarried, and must prove it. The status is handled in the same manual chapter as F-2-8, with change and extension.
rules.conditions: Family member holds F-2-8 and keeps the investment.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-8.change case '...and spouse and unmarried children', document proofOfBeingUnmarried 'For adult children' (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 6. (F-2-8, F-2-81)). 별표 1의2 24 타목 (family of 자~카목).
rules.quote: 6. 관광·휴양시설 투자 외국인에 대한 거주(F-2-8, F-2-81)자격 변경허가

rules.rule: Public-interest investment immigration: at least KRW 1.5bn in (a) the Korea Development Bank principal-guaranteed, interest-free product, or (b) a registered developer of an approved 'tourism-centred enterprise city' (profit and loss bearing). Amounts in the tourism-resort and public-interest schemes may be added together to meet the threshold. The public-interest portion must be held for 2+ years, and the combined holding for 5+ years before permanent residence. The current notice has no age-based lower amount; the former 55+ retiree tier is gone.
rules.conditions: Investor, or a corporate executive or shareholder.
rules.stacks: Can be combined with F-2-8 tourism-resort investment.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2023-319호 공익사업 투자이민제도 투자대상, 투자금액 등에 관한 기준 고시 (시행 2023-06-29), admrule-kr mirror (api-text). It is the current version.
rules.quote: (일반투자이민) 15억 원 이상 / 관광ㆍ휴양시설 투자이민제도 대상에 투자한 금액과 상기 공익사업 투자이민제도 대상에 투자한 금액을 합산하여 ... 기준금액을 충족한 것으로 간주하여 거주(F-2) 체류자격 부여 / 공익사업 투자이민 대상에 투자한 기간은 2년 이상이어야 함

rules.rule: Permanent residence (F-5-21) after keeping the investment for 5 years. A separate conditional PR (F-5-25) exists for KRW 3bn or more in the KDB principal-guaranteed product with a 5-year pledge; it covers the spouse and unmarried children, and early withdrawal cancels the PR.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2023-319호 Ⅱ, Ⅲ.
rules.quote: 공익사업 투자이민제도 투자대상 중 원금보장ㆍ무이자형에 30억 원 이상을 투자하고 5년 이상 투자 상태를 유지하고자 하는 자와 그 배우자 및 미혼자녀 / 예치한 금액 중 일부 또는 전부를 중도 인출할 경우 영주자격 취소

rules.rule: Family of a public-interest investor: the spouse and unmarried children, adult unmarried children included. Changed in Korea in the same manual chapter as F-2-12 (chapter 7, F-2-12, 13, 14). No income or language test.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-12.change, case 'Investor ..., the investor's spouse and unmarried children' (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 7. 공익사업투자 외국인에 대한 거주(F-2-12,13,14)). 별표 1의2 24 타목.
rules.quote: 7. 공익사업투자 외국인에 대한 거주(F-2-12,13,14) 체류자격 변경허가

rules.rule: Two separate grounds. (1) 가목: minor foreign child of a Korean national (under 19). (2) 나목: a person born of a marriage, including a de facto marriage, with a Korean national, recognised by the Minister of Justice. Ground (2) has no age limit. No income or language test.
rules.effect: An adult can hold F-2-2 under 나목.
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의2 24 가목 and 나목, as quoted by the earlier audit. data/visadocs.yaml F-2-2.change case '(1) A Korean national's minor foreign child; (2) a child born of a marriage (incl. de facto) with a Korean national'.
rules.quote: 나. 국민과 혼인관계(사실상의 혼인관계를 포함한다)에서 출생한 사람으로서 법무부장관이 인정하는 사람

rules.rule: Routes. In Korea: change of status; a minor child already on F-1-1 is changed to F-2-2 on confirmation, with no fee. From abroad, at the consul's discretion: case (1) gets a single-entry visa for up to 90 days; case (2) gets a 5-year multiple-entry visa with stays of up to 1 year.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-2 (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 1. 국민의 외국인자녀; 사증발급 매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 30 › 공관장 재량 2·3).
rules.quote: A Korean national's minor foreign child already staying on F-1-1 is changed to F-2-2 on confirmation, with no fee

rules.rule: Recognised refugee (별표 1의2 24 다목), granted by change of status in Korea after recognition (normally from G-1-5). No income, asset or language test. In the manual the refugee's spouse and minor children are extended on F-1.

rules.rule: Special contributor: someone the Minister of Justice recognises as having made a special contribution to Korea or to the public interest (별표 1의2 24 카목). It is a discretionary grant with no application route and no published income or language test. The spouse and children fall under 타목. Permanent residence (F-5-28) after 2 years.
rules.source: 별표 1의2 24 카목 and 별표 1의3 제19호, as quoted by the earlier audit. data/visadocs.yaml has no F-2-16 entry.

openQuestions: F-2-99 income and assets: the fixed KRW 40M own income and KRW 20M own net assets (since a guideline change dated 2025-07-07) come only from agency and law-firm summaries. The primary text (manual 2026.9.18 › 30 › 9) could not be read. Is the KRW 40M fixed or indexed? Does a transitional rule cover F-2-99 holders approved before 2025-07-07 at their next extension (the manual mentions a '기타장기(F-2-99) 체류기간 연장 심사 특례')?
F-2-99: must the applicant also meet the income rule of the status they currently hold (for example the E-7 extension wage) when it is higher? One secondary source says so.
F-2-99: how is 'continuous' stay defined? One secondary source says a departure of more than 30 days breaks continuity. Not verified.

F-2-99: can an F-3-18 spouse of an F-2-99 holder change to F-2-99 with the livelihood test assessed on the principal (allvisakorea, about 2023)? Or must they have 5 years of their own on eligible statuses?

F-2-3: does the 70%/100% household GNI rule of 고시 2015-2 (written for the consular spouse visa) apply in the same way to an in-Korea change of status? Is there a Korean-language requirement for the spouse like F-6 has? The waiver for a common child or pregnancy and the 3-year and 5-year inviter limits were seen only in a search-result summary of a consulate page.
F-2-71: does the F-2-7 holder's 1x GNI rule also bind F-2-7S (K-STAR) holders' families? Can a household (spouse) income be combined?

F-2-T: the text of 법무부고시 제2026-160호 (amended 2026-06-01) is attachment-only and could not be read. Unconfirmed: the exact degree-recency rule (one source: degree within the last 5 years), the ranking tables used, the 4x and 2x relaxations, and whether a language requirement was added.

F-2-R: the text of 법무부고시 제2026-248호 (2026-08-03) could not be read directly. The level-3 language bar rests on the in-repo manual transcription and one secondary source. Still to confirm: the 2026 list of excluded prior statuses (2024 list: D-3, D-4, E-6-2, E-8, E-9, E-10, G-1, H-1), and whether income is last year's income measured against the current year's or last year's provincial living wage.
GNI figure: immigration's KRW 52,416,000 (BoK preliminary, 2026-03-10) comes from a relay of the HiKorea notice. It should be confirmed that the June 2026 BoK revision (KRW 52.57M) is not used.
F-2-5: which KRW/USD rate (date and source) immigration uses for the US$300K and US$500K thresholds.
F-5-1 from F-2: whether the manual narrows the decree's 'any 거주(F-2) status' to certain sub-codes (for example excluding F-2-3 or F-2-71 time).
F-2-16: confirm that the sub-code F-2-16 corresponds to 카목, and which sub-code the family of a 카목 holder gets under 타목.
notes:
I picked up from the earlier ultracode run, but the network was badly restricted. WebFetch could not resolve any Korean government domain or agency blog (law.go.kr, hikorea.go.kr, moj.go.kr, immigration.go.kr, korea.kr, kcce, yoonhjs, immikorea, inha.ac.kr all failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). Only github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com worked. WebSearch worked for about 20 queries, then hit the session-wide budget of 200 searches shared by all agents. No further searching was possible, so these results stand on what was gathered before that point.

The sources actually used, in order of strength:
(1) The legalize-kr/admrule-kr GitHub mirror of law.go.kr administrative rules. It gave the full text of 법무부고시 제2015-2호 (F-2-3 spouse income), 제2023-319호 (F-2-12 public-interest investment), 제2026-29호 (F-2-8 regions and amounts) and 제2025-408호 (F-2-7 자목, the GNI-year wording). For 제2026-248호 (F-2-R, 2026-08-03), 제2026-160호 (Top-Tier, 2026-06-01) and 제2025-534호 (marriage-visa notice) it gave metadata only: they are attachment-only.
(2) data/visadocs.yaml, the in-repo transcription of the 2026.9.18 sojourn manual and the 2026.9.1 visa manual. It settled several points: the KIIP-4 proof list for F-2-99; KIIP 3, pre-test level 4 or TOPIK 3 for F-2-R; the F-2-7 family rule (below GNI means F-1 or F-3-18 instead of F-2-71); the F-3-18 / F-3-1R family statuses; and which codes are change-only.
(3) Decree quotes for 별표 1의2 24 가·나·다·라·바·카·타·파목 and 별표 1의3 제1호. These were captured verbatim from law.go.kr by the earlier audit (findings.md); for 라목 an independent verifier confirmed the quote. I could not re-read them.
(4) Search-result summaries of agency and law-firm pages. These are marked primary=false.

Key conclusions:
- The current GNI is the 2025 figure of KRW 52,416,000, applied from 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. The content page's '₩52.4M' is correct, and E-7's frozen KRW 49.95M does not apply to any F-2 code.
- The only 70% reduction in this F-2 set is F-2-3: inviting a spouse with a household of 3 or fewer.
- F-2-R's income test has been the provincial living wage (about 57-59% of GNI) since 2025-07-02, and its language bar went back to level 3 on 2026-08-03. The 2025-era findings demanding TOPIK/KIIP 4 are therefore stale; the data's level 3 is right.
- F-2-T: 3x GNI, or 4x if the degree or the career leg is missing, or 2x for an in-Korea change after 1 year.
- F-2-71 needs the F-2-7 holder's own income at or above 1x GNI.
- F-2-99 uses fixed KRW amounts, not GNI: KRW 40M own income and KRW 20M own assets, with no household combination.
- The investment codes are fixed amounts: F-2-5 in USD, F-2-8 KRW 1bn (legacy 500M/700M), F-2-12 KRW 1.5bn.
- F-2-2, F-2-4, F-2-13, F-2-81, F-2-T1 and F-2-16 have no published income or language tests.

The most consequential data problems: the F-2-T needs (a bare 5 years of experience opens it); F-2-5 gated below the statutory floor; the F-3 -> F-2-99 note; the E-7-4 -> F-2-R note (the route is via E-7-4R after 3 years); the four unreachable family codes (F-2-T1, F-2-81, F-2-13, F-2-16); the missing NONE -> F-2-71 CCVI route; and the F-2-2 / F-2-13 age gates that block eligible adults. No repository files were modified; only one scratch file was written under the session scratchpad.
